org.portico.lrc.services.saverestore.data

Class Serializer

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.portico.lrc.services.saverestore.data.Serializer

  • public class Serializer
extends Object
    This class contains all the logic that does the actual saving and restoring of LRC state data to and from a file. When you want to save, you give the save(Manifest, String) method a Manifest telling it which components need to save their data, and a file location to save the data to. The Serializer will get an output stream to the file and then give that stream to each SaveRestoreTarget inside the Manifest, tracking progress.

    The process for restoring is exactly the same, only data is read in rather than written out.

    • Method Detail

      • save

        public void save(Manifest manifest,
                 String fileLocation)
          throws SaveRestoreFailed
        Opens the file at the location provided and passes it to each of the targets in the given manifest so that they can save their contents out. If any of the targets should fail to save (as indicated by an exception), the save processing will stop and a SaveRestoreFailed will be thrown.

        If the save file already exists, it will be overwritten. If there is a problem opening the file or writing to it, a SaveRestoreFailed will be thrown.

        Parameters:
        manifest - The manifest containing references to the SaveRestoreTargets to save
        fileLocation - The location of the file to save to
        Throws:
        SaveRestoreFailed - If there is a problem opening the file or any of the targets fail when attempting to save their data out.

      • restore

        public void restore(Manifest manifest,
                    String fileLocation)
             throws SaveRestoreFailed
        Opens the file at the given location for reading. The input stream is passed to each SaveRestoreTarget in the Manifest, allowing them to read in data that was previously persisted. If there is a problem during this process (or the file cannot be located or opened), an exception is thrown.
        Parameters:
        manifest - Manifest containing references to all the targets that want to restore data
        fileLocation - The location of the file to read LRC state data from
        Throws:
        SaveRestoreFailed - If there is a problem finding or reading the file, or restoring state data from it
